decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core coating-system business and can likely be maintained as a niche option at limited incremental cost, while two years of continued listing do not indicate clear failure.
A dedicated product page in both years and evidence of earlier field testing suggest the pump has moved beyond pure experimentation, so the option is still worth keeping open.
Because it reuses proven air-motor technology, technical uncertainty and carrying costs are low, making it cheap for the firm to keep this adjacent product on the market.
As a separately promoted monitoring product that supports the firm's move toward more digital and interoperable solutions, it remains a strategically useful option despite some adjacency risk.

This is the newest and therefore most uncertain launch, but it is close to the firm's established spraying expertise, so management would likely keep it on the market until more demand information arrives.
